'''Dac's moon''' was the single moon of [[Dac/Legends|Dac]], also known as Mon Calamari.

==History==
During [[Admiral/Legends|Admiral]] [[Natasi Daala|Daala's]] [[Attack on Mon Calamari|invasion]] of Dac, she used the moon to hide the ''[[Manticore]]'' behind, planning to launch a surprise attack on the orbital shipyards. However, [[Gial Ackbar/Legends|Gial Ackbar]] foiled her plans by crashing the half-constructed [[MC90 Star Cruiser]] ''[[Startide]]'' into it. The explosion was described as having created a short eclipse of the moon.
